title: Ops console
blurb: Metrics, charts, a deploy table and a live-looking log stream inside the app shell.

title: Social feed
blurb: A three-column timeline with a composer, post cards, menus and a mobile bottom nav.

title: Swipe profiles
blurb: A phone-shaped card stack with like / skip actions, keyboard hints and a match dialog.

title: Team chat
blurb: Server rail, channel sidebar, grouped messages, reactions and an autosizing composer.

title: Product landing
blurb: Hero, feature grid, a product shot built from real components, pricing tiers and a FAQ.

title: Personal blog
blurb: A narrow reading column with post list, prose, code blocks, tags and pagination.

title: Media tracker
blurb: Poster grid or table of everything you watched, with filters, scores and a rating dialog.

title: Storefront
blurb: A product page with gallery, variant pickers, quantity stepper, cart toasts and related items.

title: Mail client
blurb: Folders, a triage list with keyboard hints, a reading pane, compose dialog and search palette.

title: Project board
blurb: Columns of issue cards with priorities, assignees, an issue dialog and a show-done switch.

title: Music player
blurb: A playlist page with a track table, a now-playing row and a fixed transport bar.

title: Account settings
blurb: Every form control in one place: profile, notifications, security, API keys — plus a sign-in screen.
